faqs.question: Does Input Group support theming?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose an appearance and override the paired --zui-input-group-* light and dark CSS variables.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body: An input shell for prefixes, suffixes, and adjacent actions.

sections.heading: API
sections.body: Place text addons and action buttons beside a shared input.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body: Add a visible label or aria-label to the input. Addons remain text, and actions are native buttons.

sections.heading: Next.js integration notes
sections.body: Import the static subpath in a Client Component when interactive state is needed.
